subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: After the atomicity defect is repaired, should plugin-runtime callers fail closed on legacy ownerless session rows without a migration path?
rationale: This changes security and upgrade behavior for already persisted session state, so source inspection cannot choose the permanent recovery contract.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject ownerless rows, document operator or non-plugin recovery, and require deployed behavior proof.

options.title: Migrate first
options.body: Add an explicit doctor or ownership-adoption migration before strict enforcement.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows, document operator or non-plugin recovery, and require deployed behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current session storage projection, lifecycle writer, and sibling delete ownership behavior.
